title: Reduce the moved-witness collar to centered off-diagonal coherence
question: Can FI-2b be localized before estimating by pinching the doubled collision witness in the coordinate algebra and paying only for its centered off-diagonal coherence?
method: Define the finite coordinate pinching D(X)=sum_x Pi_x X Pi_x in the joint basis of the onsite coordinate PVM.
Center every moved collision witness by c=Tr(omega X), with omega=rho tensor rho, and set X_perp=(X-cI)-D(X-cI).
Use that the doubled coordinate bond generator B and D(X-cI) are diagonal in the same basis to prove [B,X]=[B,X_perp].
Apply two Hilbert--Schmidt Cauchy inequalities to obtain |Tr(omega[B,X])| <= ||B||_omega (||omega^(1/2)X_perp||_HS + ||X_perp omega^(1/2)||_HS).
Run the exact R-362 Q3 fixture over both split orientations, time signs, every prefix, both history adjoints, beta values and local sites in primary and non-importing independent lanes.
Formalize the finite entrywise diagonal/off-diagonal and scalar-centering identities in Lean R363.
finding: R-363 advances FI-2b at finite level. The diagonal conditional expectation removes the bond-invisible component exactly, and the two-sided state-weighted Cauchy bound passes all 256 finite contexts in both lanes. Primary passes 778/778 and independent passes 519/519; integrated 46/46 and Lean R363 pass. The maximum reduction error is 8.489e-14, the maximum diagonal commutator is 8.487e-14, the maximum bound violation is -3.897e-15, and the minimum nonzero off-diagonal Frobenius norm is 0.565970. The remaining off-diagonal weighted norm is therefore nontrivial.
decision_reason: Pinching before estimating removes a precisely identified diagonal contribution without assuming that the Gibbs state commutes with the bond. It supplies a finite state-weighted shell inequality with Cauchy constant one and isolates the only quantity that must be made uniform. The result does not yet provide that uniform estimate.

adversarial_review.check: The two commutator terms are factorized separately, so no omega-B commutation is assumed.
The bond generator is coordinate diagonal in the independently computed joint basis; residual commutators are roundoff-level.
Scalar centering changes neither the commutator nor the off-diagonal part.
V=2 and cutoffs 3,4 do not bound off-diagonal weighted norms in larger volumes or cutoffs.
The Cauchy bound controls an infinitesimal bond generator expectation, not a finite-time local influence.
The independent lane reconstructs the oscillator, Hamiltonian, Gibbs state, PVM, witness, prefix products and pinching without importing the primary module.
Lean proves finite entrywise algebra only; numerical matrix rows and all QFT limits remain outside the kernel.

next_action: Stress the normalized off-diagonal weighted norms at larger cutoffs and graph volumes. Seek a modular or Lieb--Robinson estimate uniform in source, cutoff, volume, prefix and exhaustion shape; register a scoped growth obstruction if the stress diverges.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite exact reduction and finite actual-Q3 diagnostic. No local collar theorem, phase-weight theorem, common core, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, mass gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A or Pre-A closure follows.
no_overclaim: The exact pinching reduction and finite state-weighted inequality identify the remaining norm but do not establish its required uniformity.
